blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Oriental Mindoro is celebrating the fourth top-ranking examinee in this year’s Physician Licensure Examination (PLE), who has family roots in Calapan City. A graduate of the University of the Philippines College of Medicine, Dr. Israel Miña Aguba, who placed fourth in the exam with a 94.75 percent rating, is the son of two respected members of the judiciary: Regional Trial Court Judge Victor Aguba (RTC Branch 255, Las Piñas) and Judge Edith Miña-Aguba (RTC Branch 100, Quezon City).
